notes.title: Linked Mask Game Boy Port is live on Kickstarter!!!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44879444/0d22608d87bc7155d02e0646ba3f9768626441ad.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44879444/ab5dd001c9ded92dbf97b8bdcbdfd2157415e77d.png[/img]

Finally after a lot of effort we bring you the [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/mekanicalvoid/linked-mask-gameboy-port][b]Kickstarter[/b][/url] of the Gameboy version of Linked Mask!
The truth is that it has always been our dream to create a game for the original console, as you could see in the original PC game, we did our best to make the game have a gameboy aesthetic, now in collaboration with more friends this is possible!

[previewyoutube=fweISX0y6mU;full][/previewyoutube]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44879444/1752c9666490a2f544926cfb4cd718f40b743a67.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44879444/2a4d2691b7d335a27dda725e7c33a6211aeea0ce.gif[/img]

As you can see, we have tried to keep the style of the videogame so that it adapts well to the limitations of the console without losing its characteristic style!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44879444/c022d06a3ce96669bd3c5365cbebf3d3fd98e0a5.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44879444/4304a85dc8ff7a6f46846ceed2f3b7f0dde2a86a.gif[/img]

So thank you very much for the interest you have had in the game, due to budget issues we could not continue fixing it or adding new features, believe me I really want it to be so but it has been extremely complicated, so I put the effort to create this version, I hope you like the demo!

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/mekanicalvoid/linked-mask-gameboy-port][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44879444/8bf1cacfbf2906ad086e8b31e1a3ec939da34901.gif[/img][/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44879444/a8df1230f81360a9e4d77872dfdb817a6eba5b2a.png[/img]

notes.title: Unlinked Mask joins to Freedom Games!!!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!
We are really happy that we have formed a new partnership with Freedom games!

The launch of the game was a success and we are still working on fixing the bugs in the controls but there is almost nothing left! 

Freedom games has helped many developers and we literally believe that this union will help us reach many more players and people who are really interested in the games we want to create! Thank you very much indeed!

You can check the list of published games [url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/freedomgames]here[/url]!
